
name: Apply JuhudManager V2 D1 Migrations

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      confirmation:
        description: "Type APPLY to confirm production database migration"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - NO
          - APPLY
        default: NO

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: juhudmanager-v2-production-migrations
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  migrate:
    name: Apply V2 Production D1 Migrations
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    if: ${{ inputs.confirmation == 'APPLY' }}

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: v2

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Install V2 dependencies
        run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Apply remote D1 migrations
        run: >
          npx wrangler d1 migrations apply
          juhudmanager-v2-db
          --remote
          --config wrangler.jsonc
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
